items.raw_excerpt: There are more jobs in the provinces than I realised, despite many high profile closures. And I met local business owners for whom it's more than just business.
items.summary_en: There are more jobs in small towns than many people think, despite some big business closures. Local business owners say their work means more than just making money.
items.summary_ko: 큰 회사들이 문을 닫은 곳도 있지만, 작은 마을에는 생각보다 더 많은 일자리가 남아 있습니다. 현지 상인들은 자신들의 일이 단지 돈을 버는 것만이 아니라는 이야기를 전합니다.
items.title_en: The truth about jobs in small towns
items.title_ko: 작은 마을의 일자리 이야기
items.title_original: Revisiting zombie towns: The truth about jobs in the provinces

items.raw_excerpt: Spending 60-70% of his free time preparing for the SAT, a 12th-grade student scored a perfect 1600 on his first attempt, placing him among the top 1% of test takers worldwide.
items.summary_en: A 12th-grade student in Vietnam got a perfect 1600 score on his first SAT attempt. He spent 60 to 70 percent of his free time studying for the test. The score put him in the top 1 percent of test takers worldwide.

items.raw_excerpt: A Baja California judge ordered the medical review board to accept a complaint of medical malpractice filed by an Oregon woman.
items.summary_en: A judge in Baja California told a medical review board to accept a complaint. An Oregon woman filed the complaint about a medical treatment she got in Tijuana. She says the treatment hurt her.

items.summary_en: An indoor sports centre in Wellington is closing one of its sites after nearly 20 years. Regular users will need to find another place to play.

items.summary_en: Puerto Montt's ticket prices for the match against Colo Colo drew criticism from fans of both teams. Many thought 25,000 pesos was too expensive for local supporters.

items.raw_excerpt: The Pink Cliffs at Heathcote are a unique remnant of 1800s gold mining and have become a tourist hotspot as people seek the perfect photograph for social media.
items.summary_en: The Pink Cliffs near Heathcote in Victoria are red rock left over from gold mining in the 1800s. More and more visitors now come there to take photos for social media. Some visitors are said to damage the cliffs while they are there.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아주 헤스코트 근처의 핑크 클리프스는 1800년대 금광 채굴이 남긴 붉은 암벽입니다. 요즘은 소셜 미디어에 올릴 사진을 찍으러 많은 사람이 찾아옵니다. 일부 방문객이 절벽을 훼손하고 있다는 이야기도 나옵니다.
items.title_en: TikTok Tourists Flock to Victoria's Pink Cliffs
items.title_ko: 빅토리아주 핑크 클리프스에 몰려온 틱톡 여행자들

items.raw_excerpt: Agentes da CTTU estarão nos locais para orientar a população; Prefeitura do Recife também reformou as vias próximas à BR-232 e à Av. Abdias de Carvalho
items.summary_en: The city of Recife built a new bridge worth 7 million reais in the west zone and gave it to local people. CTTU traffic agents will stand at the bridge to guide cars and walkers. The city also fixed the roads near BR-232 and Av. Abdias de Carvalho.
items.summary_ko: 레시페시는 서부 지역에 700만 레알 규모의 새 다리를 지어 열쇠를 건네며 열었다. CTTU 교통 안내 직원들이 현장에 서서 차와 보행자를 인도해 준다. 도시는 BR-232 고속도로와 아브디아스 드 카발루아비아누 대로 주변 도로도 함께 손질했다.
items.title_en: Recife opens new 7 million real bridge in west zone

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico’s largest international airline, Aeroméxico, has announced plans to suspend its flights to Tulum starting Thursday.
items.summary_en: Aeromexico, Mexico's largest airline, will stop flying to Tulum airport. Wednesday is the last day of its flights there. The airline did not say why it is ending the service.

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland Council's governing body has voted to move to in-person booth voting for the next local elections in 2028.
items.summary_en: The governing body of Auckland Council has voted to use in-person booth voting at the next local elections in 2028. Voters will have to go to a polling booth instead of voting online. New Zealand holds local elections every three years.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 시의회 이사회가 2028년 지방선거부터 투표소에 직접 가서 투표하는 방식으로 바꾸기로 투표로 결정했다. 앞으로 유권자는 인터넷 투표 대신 투표소로 직접 가야 한다. 뉴질랜드 지방선거는 3년마다 열린다.
items.title_en: Auckland Council votes to bring back polling booth voting in 2028
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 시의회, 2028년 지방선거부터 투표소 직접 투표 전환 결정
items.title_original: Auckland Council's governing body votes to move to in-person booth voting in 2028

items.raw_excerpt: Fresh off another act of blunt-force artistry, there can be no doubt that Roosters prop Naufahu Whyte has been the best forward in the NRL in 2026.
items.summary_en: Naufahu Whyte has been called the best forward in the NRL in 2026. The Sydney Roosters prop plays with power and hard running. Fans now wait to see what he can do in the grand final.
items.summary_ko: 나우파후 와이티는 2026년 NRL 최고의 포워드로 평가받습니다. 시드니 루스터즈의 중앙 포워드인 그는 힘찬 러닝과 강한 밀치기 플레이가 강점입니다. 이제 그가 결승전에서 무얼 보여줄지 주목됩니다.

items.summary_en: A 12th-grade student in Vietnam studied for the SAT on his own for 60 to 70 percent of his free time. He scored a perfect 1600 on his first attempt. That puts him in the top 1 percent of test takers worldwide.

items.raw_excerpt: Travelling off-road? You might want to check that you are near one of WA's four-wheel-drive ambulances first.
items.summary_en: Geraldton in Western Australia now has the state's first four-wheel-drive ambulance van. It was bought after staff struggled to reach patients on remote roads. The van can travel on rough dirt tracks to reach emergencies.
items.summary_ko: 서부 오스트레일리아의 제럴튼에 처음으로 사륜구동 구급차 한 대가 도입됐다. 거친 비포장길을 달려야 하는 situations에서 환자에게 닿기 어려워 나온 차량이다. 이 차량은 오솔길이긴 삐 Evil한 지형도 달려갈 수 있다.
items.title_en: Midwest town gets its first four-wheel-drive ambulance
items.title_ko: 미드웨스트 최초의 사륜구동 구급차 등장
items.title_original: Midwest gets first four-wheel-drive ambulance van following emergencies

items.raw_excerpt: Life expectancy in several Pacific Island countries remains "below average" in comparison to global averages, despite a significant increase in average life expectancy since 1960.
items.summary_en: Experts say life expectancy in several Pacific Island countries is still below the world average. Nauru has improved a lot since 1960, but it is now falling behind the other countries. The gap between Pacific nations keeps growing.
items.summary_ko: 전문가들은 여러 태평양 섬 나라의 평균 수명이 아직 세계 평균보다 낮다고 말했다. 나우루는 1960년 이후 크게 늘었지만 다른 나라에 비해 가장 뒤처졌다. 나우루는 나 자신만 나우루어라고 부른다.
items.title_en: Pacific life expectancy gains uneven, Nauru falls furthest behind
items.title_ko: 평균 수명 격차 나 widened 나우루가 가장 뒤처져
items.title_original: Pacific life expectancy gains uneven as Naoero falls furthest behind, experts say

items.summary_en: Residents of a P&T apartment in Kerala are angry about remarks by Maxy on their building problems. They are holding protests and want him to explain why the building should be pulled down.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라의 P&T 아파트 주민들이 자기 건물 문제에 대해 맥시가 한 발언에 반발하고 있다. 이들은 시위를 계속하며 맥시가 건물 철거 사유를 밝히라고 요구하고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Central Otago District Council could backtrack on plans to truck treated human effluent onto farmland after discovering the proposed site near Lauder might not be able to handle all of its sludge.
items.summary_en: A council in Otago, New Zealand may change its plan to dump treated human waste on farmland. The chosen spot near Lauder may not hold all the sludge. Council members will discuss a new option soon.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 오타고 지역 의회가 처리된 사람 폐기물을 농지에 살포뜨리던 계획을 바꿀 수 있습니다. 라우더 근처에 정한 부지가 슬러지를 모두 담지 못할 수 있기 때문입니다. 의회는 곧 다른 대안을 논의할 예정입니다.
items.title_en: Council May Change Human Waste Dumping Plan

items.raw_excerpt: (Dân trí) - Xã đảo Tam Hải là làng chài ở Đà Nẵng mang dáng hình “cá voi vươn mình”, sở hữu ghềnh đá 400 triệu năm tuổi, nghĩa địa hơn 500 mộ cá Ông và giếng cổ không cạn.
items.summary_en: Tam Hai island village in Da Nang is a fishing village shaped like a whale rising from the sea. It has rock reefs 400 million years old. More than 500 ancient whale graves and an old well that never runs dry are here.

items.title_en: A Fishing Village In Da Nang Shaped Like A Rising Whale

items.raw_excerpt: A Malaysian influencer once famous for promoting gambling says he now drives for Grab about 10 hours a day just to cover basic expenses after running up some RM1 million (US$245,000) in debt.
items.summary_en: A Malaysian influencer who was once famous for promoting gambling now drives for Grab about 10 hours a day. He says he runs up about RM1 million in debt, and the job helps him cover basic costs. He gave up his private jets and rich image for this work.
items.summary_ko: 도박 홍보로 한때 유명했던 말레이시아 인플루언서가 그랩 택시 기사를 하며 하루 약 10시간 일하고 있다. 그는 약 1백만 링깃의 빚을 지면서 이 일로 기본 생활비를 마련한다고 말한다. 사설 제트기를 타고 살았던 과거는 이제 접었다.
items.title_en: A famous gambling influencer now drives Grab for 10 hours a day to pay off RM1 million debt
items.title_ko: 도박 홍보로 유명했던 인플루언서, 1백만 링깃 빚 때문에 하루 10시간 그랩 대우
items.title_original: Gambling influencer trades private jets for Grab driver job after running up $245,000 debt

items.raw_excerpt: Demography panel seeks 15-year religion-wise data across births, vehicles, schools, property, IDs, and detention details, which states say they don’t maintain.
items.summary_en: A government panel asked Indian states for religion-caste data about births, vehicles, schools, property, voters, and detainees. Most states said they do not collect or keep this kind of data.

items.title_en: States Say They Do Not Have Caste Data
items.title_ko: 주별 인종·카스트 관련 데이터 없다고 해
